subject: Context economy: GigaToken, CaveMem and RTK must consume proof capsules, not replay raw history

body.objective: Make long-context capacity a strategic overflow path, not the default memory mechanism.
required_actions: Build a ContextCompiler projection that starts from the current WorkGraph obligation and walks only still-valid SolvedInvariant, KnownNonCause, RegressionFence, FactorValidityEnvelope, partner/foreign-twin facts and exact source slices needed by that obligation.
Store stable cross-epoch memory in CaveMem/evidence state with provenance and validity bounds; never use provider conversation history as canonical memory.
Use RTK/output compaction before injecting CLI/test/log evidence. Preserve hashes, decisive failures, bounded tails and structured metrics; discard redundant raw verbosity once durably receipted.
Use GigaToken only when the bounded proof capsule cannot retain necessary dependency coverage. Record why the expansion was needed and whether it improved semantic outcome.

Compare at least one recent high-context task under transcript-heavy versus proof-capsule context using identical acceptance gates. Measure tokens/bytes, wall time, provider cost, contradiction rate and result quality.
Feed the winning context strategy back through FactorValidityEnvelope so it can expire when provider/model/task family changes.
body.acceptance: A downstream epoch must cite/reuse prior proof addresses without rereading the full originating transcript and still pass the same gate.
